alert.title: Kinesis frontend p99 latency 8s, threshold 1s, sustained 10 min
alert.description: Customer reports of 5xx from many us-east-1 services. Cognito, CloudWatch, Lambda alarms affected. Frontend thread pool appears exhausted.

expected.notes: OS thread limit per frontend host reached after a capacity expansion increased fan-out to backend cells beyond what the threading model could handle.
